programs.title: Emma Fielding Mysteries
programs.desc: Archaeologist Emma Fielding unearths evidence of a 17th-century coastal Maine settlement that predates Jamestown, but the dead body that accompanies it embroils Emma and her students in a different kind of investigation.

programs.title: Under the Boardwalk
programs.desc: Two crabs embark on an epic journey to get home after a storm sweeps them away. Their courage soon unites their families, paving the way for great summers to come.

programs.title: No Time to Die
programs.desc: James Bond enjoys a tranquil life in Jamaica after leaving active service. His peace, though, is short-lived as his old CIA friend, Felix Leiter, shows up and asks for help. The mission to rescue a kidnapped scientist turns out to be far more treacherous than expected, leading Bond on the trail of a mysterious villain who's armed with a dangerous new technology.

programs.title: RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars
programs.desc: Bracket 1 queens enter the Werk Room where their first challenge is a Legends Only design challenge using materials from past Hall of Fame winners.

programs.title: RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars
programs.desc: All Stars compete for $100,000 and a chance to be inducted into RuPaul's Drag Race Hall of Fame.

programs.title: It Ends With Us
programs.desc: Lily Bloom moves to Boston to chase her lifelong dream of opening her own business. A chance meeting with charming neurosurgeon Ryle Kincaid soon sparks an intense connection, but as the two fall deeply in love, she begins to see sides of Ryle that remind her of her parents' relationship. When Lily's first love, Atlas Corrigan, suddenly reenters her life, her relationship with Ryle gets upended, leaving her with an impossible choice.
